content: Minoxidil has the potential to exacerbate chest pain (angina) or lead to other cardiac complications. It is crucial to attend all scheduled appointments with your healthcare provider to monitor for any symptoms or changes in your condition. If you experience new or worsening chest pain while taking this medication, contact your doctor immediately. Your physician may prescribe additional medications to complement your minoxidil therapy. Do not discontinue any prescribed medications without explicit instructions from your doctor. It functions by relaxing blood vessels, allowing blood to circulate more easily throughout the body. In some cases, minoxidil may be prescribed for off-label uses. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for further details. Minoxidil is available in tablet form and is taken orally, typically once or twice daily. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and ask your doctor or pharmacist for clarification if needed. Take the medication exactly as prescribed, without altering the dosage or frequency. Continue taking the medication even if you feel well, and do not stop without consulting your doctor. Before starting minoxidil, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to minoxidil or any other medications. Provide a complete list of all prescription and nonprescription drugs you are taking, especially other antihypertensive medications, diuretics (commonly referred to as water pills), guanethidine, and any vitamins or supplements. Notify your doctor if you have a history of heart disease, heart attack, pheochromocytoma, or kidney disease. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, inform your doctor. Should you become pregnant while taking minoxidil, contact your doctor immediately. If you are scheduled for surgery, including dental procedures, inform the surgeon or dentist that you are taking minoxidil. Be aware that this medication may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you understand how it affects you. Discuss with your doctor the safe use of alcohol while on minoxidil, as alcohol can exacerbate its side effects. Your doctor may recommend a low-salt or low-sodium diet while you are taking minoxidil. Follow these dietary instructions carefully. If you miss a dose of minoxidil, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is nearly time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to compensate for a missed one. Minoxidil may cause side effects. Notify your doctor if any of the following symptoms are severe or persistent: increased size or darkening of fine body hair, dizziness, breast tenderness, rash, headache, upset stomach, or vomiting. Serious side effects require immediate medical attention. These include a rapid heartbeat, swelling of the ankles or feet, unexplained weight gain, difficulty breathing, or fainting. If you experience any severe side effects, you or your doctor can report them to the FDA's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program. Store minoxidil in its original container, tightly sealed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture, and do not store it in the bathroom. Dispose of expired or unused medication properly by consulting your pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, contact your local poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. If the individual has collapsed or is not breathing, call emergency services at 911. Attend all follow-up appointments with your doctor and laboratory. Your doctor may also order tests such as an electrocardiogram (EKG) to assess heart function. You may be instructed to monitor your pulse daily; ask your doctor or pharmacist for guidance on how to do this. Notify your doctor if your resting heart rate increases by more than 20 beats per minute. Weigh yourself daily and report any rapid weight gain to your doctor. Do not share this medication with others. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, consult your pharmacist. Minoxidil is sold under the brand name Loniten®.
